Easter Life of Jesus helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

In this part you learn to explain the importance of with church offerings. when you find lost respecting other peoples items for ●. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the importance of with church offerings. when you find lost respecting other peoples items for ●.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the importance of with church offerings. when you find lost respecting other peoples items for ●. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Easter Life of Jesus is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Easter Life of Jesus to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the importance of with church offerings. when you find lost respecting other peoples items for ●.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Easter Life of Jesus from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Easter Life of Jesus: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Easter Life of Jesus?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.
